round.label: corner rounding
round.tip: how much corners are rounded, in px (0 keeps the collision map's square corners)

aa.label: edge softness
aa.tip: anti-aliasing width of wall edges, in px; the originals are about 1

sharpen.label: sharpen
sharpen.tip: unsharp mask over the finished art (0 is off)

sides.label: Wall sides
sides.tip: Built like the originals: the wall art is copied, darkened and scaled down slightly toward the camera point, again and again, under the walls.

steps.label: copies
steps.tip: how many darkened copies (0: no sides)

scale.label: scale per copy
scale.tip: each copy is this much smaller (0.001 = 0.1%), toward the camera point; far from it the sides get deeper

darken.label: first copy brightness
darken.tip: brightness of the copy right under the wall (1 = as bright as the wall top)

fade.label: fade per copy
fade.tip: each deeper copy is this much darker

cx.label: camera x
cx.tip: the point the walls lean away from, as a fraction of the level width

cy.label: camera y
cy.tip: as a fraction of the level height

width.label: width
width.tip: px of floor around each chasm (0: none)

period.label: stripe period
period.tip: px from one stripe to the next

texture.label: texture
texture.tip: a PNG in tools/art/parts (e.g. hazard.png) tiled along the stripe angle instead of the two colours

lights.label: Lights
lights.tip: Each lit decor piece (effect glow) casts a pool of its own colour onto the floor and walls around it, blended as light (it brightens what's there, tinted), plus a small bloom on its bright core.

radius.label: pool size
radius.tip: radius of the light pool, in sprite sizes (0: no pool)

intensity.label: pool brightness
intensity.tip: how much the pool brightens what it falls on

greebles.label: Greebles (placement)
greebles.tip: Used by Re-place decor. Some greebles can stick out past the wall edge. Decor is only drawn: it never changes collision.png.

count.label: count
count.tip: how many greebles to try to place

size.label: max size
size.tip: largest short side, in px (they also fit the wall's thickness)

overhang.label: overhang
overhang.tip: how far, in px, one may stick out past the wall edge (0: always inside)

chance.label: overhang share
chance.tip: share of greebles that try to stick out

panels.label: Floor panels (placement)
panels.tip: Used by Re-place decor. Plated floor areas embossed into the floor (lit from the top-left), like the start pads in levels 0-2; the level's entrance always gets one.

count.label: count
count.tip: how many panels besides the entrance pad

minScale.label: min size
minScale.tip: smallest scale of the panel sprites (100-320 px at 1)

lights.label: corner lights share
lights.tip: share of panels with a light in each corner

depth.label: emboss depth
depth.tip: how strongly the panels' edges catch the light (Bake art)
